name: Eternal

snapshot.about: Eternal operates food delivery, quick commerce (Blinkit), and other technology platforms in India.

narrative: Management targets rapid growth with food delivery order growth reaching 15% year-on-year and quick commerce quarterly volume up 21%. However, Q2 FY27 net profit reached only ₹125 crore on revenue of ₹24,138 crore, leaving EBITDA margin slim at 3.1%.

promises.statement: Net working capital is not expected to exceed 18 days.

said.quote: Even though we might see capex per store going up over the next few quarters, we don't expect net working capital to be beyond those 18 days that we had shared earlier

actual_source.quote: Currently, as we have mentioned in question five, we are at 14 days

promises.note: Blinkit net working capital was reported at 14 days in Q1 FY27.

promises.statement: Food delivery year-on-year growth is expected to slowly trend up towards 20%.

said.quote: we expect year-on-year growth to continue slowly trending up towards 20% YoY, is what our current sense on the market is

actual_source.quote: in food, order growth was 15% YoY but the active delivery partners on a monthly basis went up by 30%

promises.note: Food delivery order growth reached 15% year-on-year in Q4 FY26.

promises.statement: Management expects steady-state net working capital days for Blinkit to reduce to 12 days.

said.quote: The 12 days that we are saying here is a steady-state estimate right now

actual_source.quote: Currently, as we have mentioned in question five, we are at 14 days

promises.note: Blinkit current net working capital was 14 days in Q1 FY27 near 12-day target.

promises.statement: Management maintains high confidence of Blinkit margins reaching 5% to 6% of NOV in the long term.

said.quote: in the long term, in our letter we have mentioned that our confidence on margins going to 5% to 6% of NOV remains high

promises.statement: Going-out business losses are expected to trend sequentially towards breakeven in four to six quarters.

said.quote: we now expect the losses to come down sequentially from here towards breakeven in the next four to six quarters

promises.statement: Company guides to a 60% NOV CAGR for quick commerce over three years.

said.quote: We've given overall guidance of 60% CAGR and that would obviously mean some reasonable store expansion

promises.statement: Quick commerce margin is targetted to reach 5-6% at steady state.

said.quote: As we move to 5-6% margin that we are saying we will get to at some point, contribution margin will go up

promises.statement: Management targets a long-term GAAP EBIT margin of 4% for Blinkit.

said.quote: And then you get to a GAAP EBIT margin of 4% as long-term

promises.statement: Management expects long-term Adjusted EBITDA margin for Blinkit to be close to 6%.

said.quote: One last question - that comment on EBIT margin of 4% and Adjusted EBITDA margin of close to 6%

promises.statement: Food delivery margins are expected to remain broadly flattish over the next one to two years.

said.quote: broadly, over the next 1 or 2 years, we expect the margins to remain flattish

promises.statement: Dark stores in quick commerce are expected to reach around 11 lakh INR NOV per day in steady state.

said.quote: We gave guidance last time that in steady state it could get to about INR 11 lakh per day per store

promises.statement: Management targets $1 billion overall EBITDA by FY29.

said.quote: First question is on the overall EBITDA guidance or indication of $1 billion by FY29

actual_source.quote: We maintain that guidance as of now

promises.statement: Management maintains its guidance of achieving 1 billion USD in Adjusted EBITDA by FY29.

said.quote: We maintain that guidance as of now

actual_source.quote: First question is on the overall EBITDA guidance or indication of $1 billion by FY29

promises.statement: Management maintained guidance of $3 billion NOV for the going-out business in FY30.

said.quote: You've maintained your $3 billion NOV guidance for going-out in FY30, which would imply north of 30% CAGR over the next four years

promises.statement: Management guides capex per store for quick commerce to be around INR 2.5 crore.

said.quote: You say on a per store basis, one should look at around INR 2.5 crore of capex

actual_source.quote: You added around 200 stores this quarter, but your capex was around INR 700 crore

promises.statement: Management expects to reach 3,000 dark stores by March.

said.quote: On store addition, we're on track on our guidance for March of 3,000 stores

cash.read: Profits do not convert to cash, with total free cash flow negative at ₹2,988 crore over five years and inventory days expanding from 11 to 26.

bull.point: Quick commerce order growth exceeded 90% year-on-year in Q4 FY26, alongside 21% quarter-on-quarter volume expansion in Q1 FY27.

evidence.quote: In QC, the order growth was slightly above 90%, but the rider growth was 120%
you did deliver 21% QoQ volume growth

bull.point: Food delivery maintained steady growth with 15% year-on-year order expansion in Q4 FY26 and segment EBITDA margin reaching 5.5%.

evidence.quote: in food, order growth was 15% YoY but the active delivery partners on a monthly basis went up by 30%
We are at 5.5% from a margin perspective

bull.point: Net working capital for Blinkit stood at 14 days in Q1 FY27, approaching the steady-state target of 12 days.

evidence.quote: Currently, as we have mentioned in question five, we are at 14 days
The 12 days that we are saying here is a steady-state estimate right now

bear.point: Free cash flow was negative in four out of five years, resulting in cumulative cash burn of ₹2,988 crore.

evidence.quote: Free cash flow was negative in 4 of 5 years, −₹2,988 crore in total.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bear.point: Inventory days increased significantly from 11 to 26 days between FY24 and FY26, tying up working capital longer in business operations.

evidence.quote: Inventory days rose from 11 to 26 between FY24 and FY26: cash is waiting longer in the business.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bear.point: Tax demand orders received from GST authorities on delivery charges created legal uncertainty as noted in the auditor report.

evidence.quote: We draw attention to Note 37(a) to the consolidated financial statement relating to the orders received by the Company from GST authorities in respect of GST on delivery charges
